content.title_original: Postgraduate Curriculum in Rare Neurological Diseases — Ataxia/HSP module
content.description_original: For medical doctors in or after specialist training in neurology, child neurology, medical genetics or a related specialty. Completion includes online tests, a supervised logbook/portfolio and an oral examination.

legacy.delivery: Flexible online learning plus a 3–6 month supervised stay at an approved rare-neurology expertise centre
legacy.duration: Up to 3 years per module; online path within 18 months, followed by the expert-centre stay
legacy.certificate_or_recognition: UEMS-approved pathway towards the European Certificate in Rare Neurological Diseases
